input: My twelve-person services firm is profitable but has been stuck at the same revenue for eighteen months. I keep telling everyone to be more proactive. Senior people protect their own client work because bonuses depend on personal billings, nobody owns packaging repeatable offers, and every custom proposal starts from scratch. I want us to stop being so mediocre.
